measurementAdjudications.reason: Fifteen first-row glyph span boxes per text viewport extend 3.015625px above the nb scrolling box. observations.text-desktop: All eleven paragraphs, algebraic four-row proof, table in its original prose position, and complete two-class set proof are visible. No visually established missing math glyph. Table is unshrunk and nonblank.
observations.exercises-desktop: E70 header and complete Latin a)/b) formulas retained and separated. No collision or visibly broken formula; final return link visible.
observations.choices-desktop: Two questions and eight unselected native controls visible. A-D labels align independently of text; all four class lines are present in each second-question option. Class numerals visibly use the smaller prose font.
observations.text-mobile: Complete lesson continues below the fixed-width table. Table and aligned proof intentionally overflow their own horizontal scroll windows, not the document. Both proof classes and final recurrence are visible. No visually established missing math glyph.
observations.exercises-mobile: Complete a) and b) retained. The b) formula wraps below its label and has a measured reachable 15px horizontal scroll end. No letter/formula collision or document overflow.
observations.choices-mobile: A-D labels do not collide with wrapped options. All four class lines remain separated for each single-choice option; bottom option and final return link are present. Class numerals visibly use the smaller prose font.
